facts.value: Quoted rate shall include all charges towards transportation, lead, lift, mathadi charges , Octroi, installation, levies, royalties, WCP & CAR insurance & other applicable insurances, ESI & PF premiums, overheards, fees and rectification of defects or replacement of defective material.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 16
facts.value: Scope of Work and Pricing Requirements

facts.subject: General Notes · line 17
facts.value: The rates and prices quoted shall be deemed to include the entire scope of work as defined in the Drawings, Specifications, and BOQ.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 18
facts.value: The quoted unit rates shall be comprehensive and shall include the cost of all labour, materials, plants, tools, tackles, equipment, transportation, loading, unloading, wastage, scaffolding, staging, overheads, profits, and all incidental expenses necessary for the proper execution and completion of the works.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 19
facts.value: The Contractor shall make necessary provisions in the rates for all contingencies, difficulties, or unforeseen circumstances that may arise during the execution of the works, ensuring the satisfactory completion of the project.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 20
facts.value: For the valuation of variations, any addition or omission to the Contract Sum shall be based on the measured quantities applying the relevant unit rates (or pro-rated unit rate, as the case may be) contained in the BOQ. Contractors are therefore advised to quote each item in a fair, realistic, and complete manner.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 21
facts.value: Unless otherwise specifically stated, the tendered rates shall be inclusive of all duties, levies, royalties, insurance, freight, loading, unloading, storage, protection, wastages, and safety provisions at site.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 22
facts.value: The rates quoted shall also include all costs for preparing and presenting mock-ups, providing samples and prototypes for approval prior to mass procurement, and obtaining written approval from the Client / Consultant.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 24
facts.value: Items Deemed to be Included in the Quoted Rates

facts.subject: General Notes · line 4
facts.value: GENERAL NOTES COVERING BILL OF QUANTITIES

facts.subject: General Notes · line 25
facts.value: Unless specifically stated otherwise, the quoted rates for each item shall be deemed to include but not be limited to the following:

facts.subject: General Notes · line 26
facts.value: a) Supply of all materials, fittings, fixtures, and accessories required for execution, including transportation to site, unloading, safe storage, handling, and protection till completion.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 27
facts.value: b) All necessary labour, supervision, skilled and unskilled manpower, and tools required for satisfactory execution of work at all heights, levels, and confined spaces.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 28
facts.value: c) Providing and subsequently removing all scaffolding, staging, platforms, ladders, safety barricades, and other temporary works required for execution, including double height areas, partitions, and false ceilings.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 29
facts.value: d) Hiring, operating, and maintaining all tools, plants, and machinery necessary for execution as per the specifications.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 30
facts.value: e) Receiving, unloading, storing, protecting, and handling all materials supplied either by the Employer or the Contractor, including all ancillary works required for fixing in position.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 31
facts.value: f) All costs associated with assembling, setting out, fitting, and fixing materials in position, including making necessary adjustments and allowances for overlaps, laps, jointing, and cutting wastage.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 32
facts.value: g) All necessary protection of executed works from damage and making good of any disturbed works.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 33
facts.value: h) Removal of all debris, waste, and surplus materials from the site on a regular basis and after completion of the works in compliance with site housekeeping norms.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 34
facts.value: i) All incidental works necessary for proper completion of the works, including minor items not specifically mentioned but reasonably implied.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 35
facts.value: j) All establishment charges, overheads, profits, and statutory compliance costs.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 38
facts.value: The Contractor shall visit the site before submission of tender and satisfy himself regarding the access, working space, site constraints, service routes, and other conditions likely to affect the execution of the works.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 39
facts.value: The Contractor shall verify all levels, dimensions, and conditions shown in the drawings and shall be responsible for the accuracy of the same before commencement of work.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 40
facts.value: The Contractor shall co-ordinate with all other contractors and agencies working at site for proper sequencing of work to avoid delays and conflicts.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 41
facts.value: Temporary storage of materials shall be arranged by the Contractor in areas approved by the Employer / PMC, ensuring that materials are stacked safely and without obstructing other works.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 42
facts.value: The Contractor shall arrange necessary labour, tools, and equipment for hoisting materials to upper floors and transporting debris down from elevated levels.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 43
facts.value: The Contractor shall protect existing finishes, structures, and services from damage during execution and shall make good any damage caused at his cost.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 44
facts.value: All necessary safety precautions and site-specific protection shall be maintained throughout the execution of works.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 7
facts.value: These notes shall apply to all Bills of Quantities forming part of this document.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 47
facts.value: The Contractor shall prepare and submit detailed shop drawings for all works and obtain approval from the Employer’s Representative / Consultant prior to commencement.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 48
facts.value: For all custom-made or modular furniture, the Contractor shall submit 3D rendered indicative images, detailing the design intent, finishes, and joinery construction at the time of technical bid evaluation.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 49
facts.value: Specialized and proprietary system works shall be executed strictly as per manufacturer’s specifications, standards, and installation manuals.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 50
facts.value: All makes, models, and finishes of materials shall be submitted for approval and shall not be procured or installed without written confirmation from the Employer / Consultant.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 51
facts.value: All paints, polishes, and finishes shall be LEED-compliant and conform to VOC emission standards applicable to LEED Commercial Interiors.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 52
facts.value: All proprietary system items shall be installed by authorized dealers or certified applicators, and necessary certificates shall be produced for verification.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 53
facts.value: The Contractor shall ensure adherence to quality standards for workmanship, alignment, finish, and performance as defined in the project specifications.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 56
facts.value: Quantities shall be measured in accordance with IS: 1200 – Method of Measurement of Building and Civil Engineering Works, unless otherwise specified.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 57
facts.value: All work shall be measured net as fixed in position.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 8
facts.value: The Works under this Bill shall be priced based on re-measurable quantities unless otherwise mentioned.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 58
facts.value: Partitions shall be measured from finished floor level to the underside of true ceiling, unless stated otherwise.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 59
facts.value: Column cladding areas shall be measured from finished floor to false ceiling.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 60
facts.value: Counters shall be measured on visible plan area or length, and cabinetry shall be measured from visible front elevation only.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 61
facts.value: The measurement for blinds shall be based on visible elevation area only.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 62
facts.value: For hard flooring areas (granite, marble, vitrified, etc.), payment shall be made only for the visible laid area. No extra payment shall be made for cutting, wastage, or trimming.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 63
facts.value: All wastages shall be deemed to be included in the quoted unit rates.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 64
facts.value: No additional claim shall be entertained for variations arising due to site conditions, minor adjustments, or coordination with other trades.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 67
facts.value: The Contractor shall execute all works in a neat, workmanlike, and safe manner in compliance with local regulations and building codes.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 68
facts.value: All works shall be properly sequenced with other services to ensure smooth execution and commissioning.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 9
facts.value: This Bill shall be read in conjunction with the Drawings, Specifications of Materials and Workmanship, General Conditions of Contract, and all other associated Bills of Quantities. All these documents shall be construed as being complementary to one another, and any requirement shown on one shall be binding as though it appeared on all.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 69
facts.value: The Contractor shall clear debris and waste material from the site on a daily basis to maintain cleanliness.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 70
facts.value: All common areas, builder lobbies, and access routes used by the Contractor shall be cleaned and restored to original condition upon completion.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 71
facts.value: Floors shall be scrapped, cleaned, and wet-mopped before final floor finishes such as carpets are laid.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 72
facts.value: Water and power required for execution shall be provided free of cost. However, any wastage will attract a penalty at the sole discretion of Client.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 73
facts.value: Necessary permits, gate passes, and clearances for material movement shall be arranged by the Contractor in coordination with the site management.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 76
facts.value: Commercial grade plywood shall be used in all joinery unless otherwise approved in writing by the PMC / Architect.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 77
facts.value: All furniture, storage, and tables shall be factory-finished unless specific site finishing is approved.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 78
facts.value: All gaps between slabs, glazing, columns, walls, and false floors shall be properly filled and sealed to maintain visual and acoustic integrity.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 79
facts.value: Touch-up and finishing of all existing doors and elements handed over by the builder shall form part of the Contractor’s scope.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 10
facts.value: The Contractor shall provide and execute everything reasonably necessary for the proper completion of the Works according to the true intent and meaning of the Drawings, Specifications, and Contract Documents, whether or not the same is specifically mentioned, provided that it can be reasonably inferred therefrom.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 80
facts.value: Countertop rates shall include necessary cutouts for sinks, basins, taps, and polishing of exposed edges to the satisfaction of the Architect.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 81
facts.value: All mild steel sections shall be painted with one coat of metal primer and two coats of enamel paint unless otherwise stated.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 82
facts.value: The Contractor shall ensure that all materials used are of approved make, new, free from defects, and conforming to the specifications.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 85
facts.value: All “Rate Only (R/O)”/ QRO (Quote Rate only) items shall be quoted without exception; unquoted items shall render the bid invalid.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 86
facts.value: The rates quoted under R/O items are negotiable, and only rationalized rates shall be considered during execution.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 87
facts.value: Basic rates of materials shall exclude taxes, transportation, wastages, leads, and lifts; all such costs shall be included in the quoted rate.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 88
facts.value: Taxes shall be extra as applicable at the time of billing.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 89
facts.value: The Contractor shall not be entitled to any escalation of rates during the tenure of the contract.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 90
facts.value: Any additional items required to complete the works as per scope, drawings, or specifications shall be executed without claiming extra cost unless approved in writing.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 11
facts.value: In the event of any discrepancy between the Drawings, Specifications, or any other Contract Documents, the same shall be immediately brought to the notice of the Employer’s Representative / Consultant, whose decision shall be final and binding.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 91
facts.value: The decision of the Employer / Project Manager / Consultant shall be final and binding in all matters relating to interpretation of the BOQ, specifications, and scope.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 94
facts.value: Contractor must maintain and regularly update material spreadsheets throughout construction for LEED documentation.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 95
facts.value: Track and document all applicable credits: construction & demolition waste, recycled content, regional materials, rapidly renewable materials, certified wood, low-emitting materials, etc.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 96
facts.value: Collect and file all material documentation from subcontractors and suppliers.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 97
facts.value: Schedule a mid-project audit with the LEED consultant to verify completeness of documentation.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 98
facts.value: Take and archive photographs (site work, materials, waste handling) to support LEED submission and demonstrate sustainable practices.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 101
facts.value: Contractor must ensure full compliance with the Contract Labour (Regulation & Abolition) Act, including obtaining/maintaining valid labour licence, registers, wage records, and statutory submissions.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 102
facts.value: Contractor is responsible for ensuring all subcontracted labour is legally engaged, paid as per law, and covered under applicable statutory benefits (ESI, PF, WC insurance etc.).

facts.subject: General Notes · line 12
facts.value: Tenderers shall carefully examine all drawings, specifications, site conditions, and existing services before submitting their bid, and shall satisfy themselves as to the nature and scope of the works to be carried out. No claim shall be entertained on account of lack of knowledge of site conditions.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 105
facts.value: The Contractor shall comply with all applicable laws, local regulations, labour laws, and statutory requirements during execution.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 106
facts.value: Adequate safety measures shall be implemented, including PPE usage, barricading, and fire safety equipment.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 107
facts.value: Proper signage shall be displayed for restricted zones and safety instructions.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 108
facts.value: Work shall be carried out with due care to prevent damage to adjoining properties, services, and structures.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 109
facts.value: All works shall conform to relevant Indian Standards and local building codes in force at the time of execution.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 112

facts.subject: Interior Works · Providing and fixing Acoustic Wooden Grid ceiling of 1200mm X 1200mm size, design and drawings, as instructed by Architect. Proprietory supplied ceiling suspension system to consist of 2mm or 3mm GI suspension rod/wire with adjustable butterfly clip securely affixed to structural ceiling using soffit angle fixing bracket and 10mm dia hook type anchor fastener. Ceiling suspension system to be fixed at interval (grid) of 1200mm in both directions. Grid System: Supply of proprietory Grid System to consist of Main Runners @ 600mm and joined by Cross Tees @ 600mm to form overall grid opening of 600mm x 600mm. Additional cross tees are to be placed where appropriate for light fixtures, AC diffusers. The grid system used shall be hot dipped galvanised steel sections, with exposed surfaces chemically cleaned and capped prefinished in baked polyester paint. Providing and fixing in true Horizontal Level grid ceiling G I powder coated Heavy Duty Regular Grids of main T size of 24 x 38 x 03. mm at every 1200 mm c/c Max. Cross T of size 24 x 26 x 0.30 mm at every 600 mm c/c max and 19 x 19 x 0.4 mm wall angle all round the wall to form a grid of size 600 mm x 600 mm and suspending the grid using 4 mm GI rod supported one end with anchor bolt and other end with "J " hook system at every 1200 mm interval at the main T.

facts.subject: Interior Works · Providing and fixing Acoustic Wooden Grid ceiling of 1200mm X 1200mm size, design and drawings, as instructed by Architect. Proprietory supplied ceiling suspension system to consist of 2mm or 3mm GI suspension rod/wire with adjustable butterfly clip securely affixed to structural ceiling using soffit angle fixing bracket and 10mm dia hook type anchor fastener. Ceiling suspension system to be fixed at interval (grid) of 1200mm in both directions. Grid System: Supply of proprietory Grid System to consist of Main Runners @ 600mm and joined by Cross Tees @ 600mm to form overall grid opening of 600mm x 600mm. Additional cross tees are to be placed where appropriate for light fixtures, AC diffusers. The grid system used shall be hot dipped galvanised steel sections, with exposed surfaces chemically cleaned and capped prefinished in baked polyester paint. Providing and fixing in true Horizontal Level grid ceiling G I powder coated Heavy Duty Regular Grids of main T size of 24 x 38 x 03. mm at every 1200 mm c/c Max. Cross T of size 24 x 26 x 0.30 mm at every 600 mm c/c max and 19 x 19 x 0.4 mm wall angle all round the wall to form a grid of size 600 mm x 600 mm and suspending the grid using 4 mm GI rod supported one end with anchor bolt and other end with "J " hook system at every 1200 mm interval at the main T.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 13
facts.value: Unit rates shall be inclusive of all mock-ups, samples, protection, cleaning, rectification, and housekeeping till handover.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 117
facts.value: Basic price of Fabric is INR 600/Rmt

facts.subject: General Notes · line 118
facts.value: Basic price of 12mm thk plain acoustic panel is INR180/sft

facts.subject: General Notes · line 119
facts.value: Basic price of 12mm thk grooved / printed acoustic panel is INR250/sft

facts.subject: General Notes · line 120
facts.value: Basic price of 18mm thk fluted laminated wooden panel is INR1200/piece (121mm width, 18mm thick & 2750mm height)

facts.subject: General Notes · line 121
facts.value: Basic price of 12mm thk Acrylic solid surface (Solid colours) is INR 1300/Sft (Any color approved by architect)

facts.value: Basic price of 6mm thk Acrylic solid surface (Solid Colours) is INR 950/Sft (Any color approved by architect)

facts.subject: General Notes · line 123
facts.value: Heat soaking test certificate to be provided for all the toughened glass and laminated toughened glass along with the purchased quantity.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 126
facts.value: The abbreviations used in the Specifications and Bills of Quantities shall be interpreted as follows:

facts.subject: General Notes · line 14
facts.value: Quoted rate shall include all charges towards transportation, lead, lift, mathadi charges , Octroi, installation, levies, royalties, WCP & CAR insurance & other applicable insurances, ESI & PF premiums, overheards, fees and rectification of defects or replacement of defective material.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 128
facts.value: ASTM – American Society for Testing and Materials

facts.subject: General Notes · line 16
facts.value: Scope of Work and Pricing Requirements

facts.subject: General Notes · line 17
facts.value: The rates and prices quoted shall be deemed to include the entire scope of work as defined in the Drawings, Specifications, and BOQ.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 18
facts.value: The quoted unit rates shall be comprehensive and shall include the cost of all labour, materials, plants, tools, tackles, equipment, transportation, loading, unloading, wastage, scaffolding, staging, overheads, profits, and all incidental expenses necessary for the proper execution and completion of the works.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 19
facts.value: The Contractor shall make necessary provisions in the rates for all contingencies, difficulties, or unforeseen circumstances that may arise during the execution of the works, ensuring the satisfactory completion of the project.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 20
facts.value: For the valuation of variations, any addition or omission to the Contract Sum shall be based on the measured quantities applying the relevant unit rates (or pro-rated unit rate, as the case may be) contained in the BOQ. Contractors are therefore advised to quote each item in a fair, realistic, and complete manner.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 21
facts.value: Unless otherwise specifically stated, the tendered rates shall be inclusive of all duties, levies, royalties, insurance, freight, loading, unloading, storage, protection, wastages, and safety provisions at site.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 22
facts.value: The rates quoted shall also include all costs for preparing and presenting mock-ups, providing samples and prototypes for approval prior to mass procurement, and obtaining written approval from the Client / Consultant.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 24
facts.value: Items Deemed to be Included in the Quoted Rates

facts.subject: General Notes · line 4
facts.value: GENERAL NOTES COVERING BILL OF QUANTITIES

facts.subject: General Notes · line 25
facts.value: Unless specifically stated otherwise, the quoted rates for each item shall be deemed to include but not be limited to the following:

facts.subject: General Notes · line 26
facts.value: a) Supply of all materials, fittings, fixtures, and accessories required for execution, including transportation to site, unloading, safe storage, handling, and protection till completion.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 27
facts.value: b) All necessary labour, supervision, skilled and unskilled manpower, and tools required for satisfactory execution of work at all heights, levels, and confined spaces.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 28
facts.value: c) Providing and subsequently removing all scaffolding, staging, platforms, ladders, safety barricades, and other temporary works required for execution, including double height areas, partitions, and false ceilings.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 29
facts.value: d) Hiring, operating, and maintaining all tools, plants, and machinery necessary for execution as per the specifications.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 30
facts.value: e) Receiving, unloading, storing, protecting, and handling all materials supplied either by the Employer or the Contractor, including all ancillary works required for fixing in position.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 31
facts.value: f) All costs associated with assembling, setting out, fitting, and fixing materials in position, including making necessary adjustments and allowances for overlaps, laps, jointing, and cutting wastage.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 32
facts.value: g) All necessary protection of executed works from damage and making good of any disturbed works.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 33
facts.value: h) Removal of all debris, waste, and surplus materials from the site on a regular basis and after completion of the works in compliance with site housekeeping norms.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 34
facts.value: i) All incidental works necessary for proper completion of the works, including minor items not specifically mentioned but reasonably implied.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 35
facts.value: j) All establishment charges, overheads, profits, and statutory compliance costs.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 38
facts.value: The Contractor shall visit the site before submission of tender and satisfy himself regarding the access, working space, site constraints, service routes, and other conditions likely to affect the execution of the works.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 39
facts.value: The Contractor shall verify all levels, dimensions, and conditions shown in the drawings and shall be responsible for the accuracy of the same before commencement of work.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 40
facts.value: The Contractor shall co-ordinate with all other contractors and agencies working at site for proper sequencing of work to avoid delays and conflicts.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 41
facts.value: Temporary storage of materials shall be arranged by the Contractor in areas approved by the Employer / PMC, ensuring that materials are stacked safely and without obstructing other works.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 42
facts.value: The Contractor shall arrange necessary labour, tools, and equipment for hoisting materials to upper floors and transporting debris down from elevated levels.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 43
facts.value: The Contractor shall protect existing finishes, structures, and services from damage during execution and shall make good any damage caused at his cost.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 44
facts.value: All necessary safety precautions and site-specific protection shall be maintained throughout the execution of works.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 7
facts.value: These notes shall apply to all Bills of Quantities forming part of this document.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 47
facts.value: The Contractor shall prepare and submit detailed shop drawings for all works and obtain approval from the Employer’s Representative / Consultant prior to commencement.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 48
facts.value: For all custom-made or modular furniture, the Contractor shall submit 3D rendered indicative images, detailing the design intent, finishes, and joinery construction at the time of technical bid evaluation.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 49
facts.value: Specialized and proprietary system works shall be executed strictly as per manufacturer’s specifications, standards, and installation manuals.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 50
facts.value: All makes, models, and finishes of materials shall be submitted for approval and shall not be procured or installed without written confirmation from the Employer / Consultant.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 51
facts.value: All paints, polishes, and finishes shall be LEED-compliant and conform to VOC emission standards applicable to LEED Commercial Interiors.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 52
facts.value: All proprietary system items shall be installed by authorized dealers or certified applicators, and necessary certificates shall be produced for verification.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 53
facts.value: The Contractor shall ensure adherence to quality standards for workmanship, alignment, finish, and performance as defined in the project specifications.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 56
facts.value: Quantities shall be measured in accordance with IS: 1200 – Method of Measurement of Building and Civil Engineering Works, unless otherwise specified.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 57
facts.value: All work shall be measured net as fixed in position.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 8
facts.value: The Works under this Bill shall be priced based on re-measurable quantities unless otherwise mentioned.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 58
facts.value: Partitions shall be measured from finished floor level to the underside of true ceiling, unless stated otherwise.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 59
facts.value: Column cladding areas shall be measured from finished floor to false ceiling.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 60
facts.value: Counters shall be measured on visible plan area or length, and cabinetry shall be measured from visible front elevation only.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 61
facts.value: The measurement for blinds shall be based on visible elevation area only.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 62
facts.value: For hard flooring areas (granite, marble, vitrified, etc.), payment shall be made only for the visible laid area. No extra payment shall be made for cutting, wastage, or trimming.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 63
facts.value: All wastages shall be deemed to be included in the quoted unit rates.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 64
facts.value: No additional claim shall be entertained for variations arising due to site conditions, minor adjustments, or coordination with other trades.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 67
facts.value: The Contractor shall execute all works in a neat, workmanlike, and safe manner in compliance with local regulations and building codes.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 68
facts.value: All works shall be properly sequenced with other services to ensure smooth execution and commissioning.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 9
facts.value: This Bill shall be read in conjunction with the Drawings, Specifications of Materials and Workmanship, General Conditions of Contract, and all other associated Bills of Quantities. All these documents shall be construed as being complementary to one another, and any requirement shown on one shall be binding as though it appeared on all.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 69
facts.value: The Contractor shall clear debris and waste material from the site on a daily basis to maintain cleanliness.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 70
facts.value: All common areas, builder lobbies, and access routes used by the Contractor shall be cleaned and restored to original condition upon completion.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 71
facts.value: Floors shall be scrapped, cleaned, and wet-mopped before final floor finishes such as carpets are laid.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 72
facts.value: Water and power required for execution shall be provided free of cost. However, any wastage will attract a penalty at the sole discretion of Client.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 73
facts.value: Necessary permits, gate passes, and clearances for material movement shall be arranged by the Contractor in coordination with the site management.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 76
facts.value: Commercial grade plywood shall be used in all joinery unless otherwise approved in writing by the PMC / Architect.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 77
facts.value: All furniture, storage, and tables shall be factory-finished unless specific site finishing is approved.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 78
facts.value: All gaps between slabs, glazing, columns, walls, and false floors shall be properly filled and sealed to maintain visual and acoustic integrity.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 79
facts.value: Touch-up and finishing of all existing doors and elements handed over by the builder shall form part of the Contractor’s scope.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 10
facts.value: The Contractor shall provide and execute everything reasonably necessary for the proper completion of the Works according to the true intent and meaning of the Drawings, Specifications, and Contract Documents, whether or not the same is specifically mentioned, provided that it can be reasonably inferred therefrom.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 80
facts.value: Countertop rates shall include necessary cutouts for sinks, basins, taps, and polishing of exposed edges to the satisfaction of the Architect.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 81
facts.value: All mild steel sections shall be painted with one coat of metal primer and two coats of enamel paint unless otherwise stated.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 82
facts.value: The Contractor shall ensure that all materials used are of approved make, new, free from defects, and conforming to the specifications.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 85
facts.value: All “Rate Only (R/O)”/ QRO (Quote Rate only) items shall be quoted without exception; unquoted items shall render the bid invalid.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 86
facts.value: The rates quoted under R/O items are negotiable, and only rationalized rates shall be considered during execution.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 87
facts.value: Basic rates of materials shall exclude taxes, transportation, wastages, leads, and lifts; all such costs shall be included in the quoted rate.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 88
facts.value: Taxes shall be extra as applicable at the time of billing.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 89
facts.value: The Contractor shall not be entitled to any escalation of rates during the tenure of the contract.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 90
facts.value: Any additional items required to complete the works as per scope, drawings, or specifications shall be executed without claiming extra cost unless approved in writing.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 11
facts.value: In the event of any discrepancy between the Drawings, Specifications, or any other Contract Documents, the same shall be immediately brought to the notice of the Employer’s Representative / Consultant, whose decision shall be final and binding.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 91
facts.value: The decision of the Employer / Project Manager / Consultant shall be final and binding in all matters relating to interpretation of the BOQ, specifications, and scope.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 94
facts.value: Contractor must maintain and regularly update material spreadsheets throughout construction for LEED documentation.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 95
facts.value: Track and document all applicable credits: construction & demolition waste, recycled content, regional materials, rapidly renewable materials, certified wood, low-emitting materials, etc.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 96
facts.value: Collect and file all material documentation from subcontractors and suppliers.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 97
facts.value: Schedule a mid-project audit with the LEED consultant to verify completeness of documentation.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 98
facts.value: Take and archive photographs (site work, materials, waste handling) to support LEED submission and demonstrate sustainable practices.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 101
facts.value: Contractor must ensure full compliance with the Contract Labour (Regulation & Abolition) Act, including obtaining/maintaining valid labour licence, registers, wage records, and statutory submissions.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 102
facts.value: Contractor is responsible for ensuring all subcontracted labour is legally engaged, paid as per law, and covered under applicable statutory benefits (ESI, PF, WC insurance etc.).

facts.subject: General Notes · line 12
facts.value: Tenderers shall carefully examine all drawings, specifications, site conditions, and existing services before submitting their bid, and shall satisfy themselves as to the nature and scope of the works to be carried out. No claim shall be entertained on account of lack of knowledge of site conditions.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 105
facts.value: The Contractor shall comply with all applicable laws, local regulations, labour laws, and statutory requirements during execution.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 106
facts.value: Adequate safety measures shall be implemented, including PPE usage, barricading, and fire safety equipment.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 107
facts.value: Proper signage shall be displayed for restricted zones and safety instructions.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 108
facts.value: Work shall be carried out with due care to prevent damage to adjoining properties, services, and structures.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 109
facts.value: All works shall conform to relevant Indian Standards and local building codes in force at the time of execution.

facts.subject: General Notes · line 112
facts.value: All the Basic prices mentioned below are exclusive of all the Custom duty, GST, other taxes, transportation charges, wastage & installation charges etc.. * If basic price vary, basic price variation assessment to be done * Approval process to be followed if selected material is higher than the basic price mentioned

facts.subject: General Notes · line 113
facts.value: Basic price of 1mm thk laminate is INR 100/Sft & 0.8mm thk laminate is INR 50/Sft

facts.subject: General Notes · line 114
facts.value: Basic price of 4mm thk Veneer is INR 250/Sft

facts.subject: General Notes · line 115
facts.value: Basic price of 4mm thk fluted Veneer is INR 450/Sft
